source.note: 1972 Topps Baseball, complete 787-card checklist issued across six physical series. TCDB lists no inserts. 'In Action' and 'Traded' cards are numbered base cards.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Unified Base #1-787, equal VCS pull availability despite physical high-number scarcity.
decisions.seriesHandling: Physical Series One 1-132, Two 133-263, Three 264-394, Four 395-525, Five 526-656, Six 657-787 all combined.
decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS four cards per pack and 24 packs per box. Historical wax cards-per-pack differs.
decisions.subsetHandling: In Action, Traded, Rookie Stars, Leaders, Postseason, Boyhood Photos and other numbered subjects remain in Base.
decisions.variations: Printer, error, correction, and color variations are collapsed into the printed base number, with no false parallel odds.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Only unique TCDB rookie-index numbers are recognized; individual player labels on multi-subject rookie cards require separate verification. Generator labels verified single-subject cards RC and leaves multi-subject labels pending rather than applying a potentially wrong card-wide RC.
decisions.imageHandling: Pack and card scans pending; never substitute unrelated or made-up imagery.
decisions.releaseSafety: Unreleased draft until multi-player RC audit, images, pricing and pack art approval.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One unified base set, cards #1-787 including historical In Action and Traded subjects; no synthetic base scarcity.
